headline: Brazil COP30 roadmaps for fossil fuel phaseout welcomed
summary: Social and environmental organizations responded positively to the Brazilian COP30 presidency's presentation of roadmaps for phasing out fossil fuels and ending deforestation.
why: Global climate policy frameworks and national roadmaps guide long-term capital allocation toward sustainable energy and transition assets.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy Sector
impacts.why: Fossil fuel phaseout roadmaps encourage investment shifts toward renewable energy assets.
